deadline_text_verbatim: Application filing period: October 1 - November 30. Application deadline: November 30.
limitations: Exact submission TIME not independently confirmed via a directly fetched official page in this research pass (multiple fetch attempts to pages likely to state it returned network errors); widely and consistently reported by secondary sources as 11:59 PM Pacific Time, but recorded as deadline_time=null here rather than asserting an unverified time as fact. Berkeley's own application-faqs page (fetched successfully) confirms the 11:59 PM style is how UC generally states its deadlines (used for the January 10 recommendation-letter deadline) but does not itself restate the time for November 30.
researcher_notes: TRAP CHECK: independently corroborated as October 1 - November 30 on THREE separate official pages -- admission.universityofcalifornia.edu/how-to-apply/applying-as-a-first-year/ ('You can start working on your fall application as early as August 1, and submit it by November 30' + 'Fall Quarter/Semester: October 1-November 30'), the systemwide dates-and-deadlines page (calendar-table row spanning 'October-November' / '1-30', read carefully as a single Oct-1-to-Nov-30 span rather than misread as 'November 1-30' -- see limitations below), and this Berkeley-specific dates-deadlines page, which states both 'Application filing period: October 1- November 30' and 'Application deadline: November 30' as separate line items. Also independently corroborated by an official UC Office of the President press statement fetched this pass (universityofcalifornia.edu/press-room/statement-uc-academic-senate-chair-ahmet-palazoglu-boars-undergraduate-admissions-review): 'Students applying by November 30, 2026, for fall 2027 admission...'. A 2022-09-30 UC press release (universityofcalifornia.edu/press-room/uc-expands-undergraduate-admissions-application-filing-period) confirms this Oct-1 opening is itself a deliberate 2022 expansion from a PRIOR Nov-1-30-only filing period -- meaning an assumption of 'Nov 1-30' (the pre-2022 pattern, and the pattern named as the historical UC norm in this research pass's own brief) would have been stale by four years. IMPORTANT PARSING NOTE for future re-verification: the official calendar table's raw text extraction renders this row ambiguously as 'October November [newline] 1 - 30' (month names and day-range each stacked/spanning two lines) -- a screenshot of the live page confirmed this is one merged FROM-October-TO-November, FROM-day-1-TO-day-30 row, not two separate entries; a naive text scrape could misparse it as 'November 1-30' only, so this is flagged explicitly for whoever re-scrapes this page next cycle.

deadline_text_verbatim: Deadline for applicants to submit FAFSA, California Dream Act Application and GPA Verification Form.
limitations: FAFSA is federal financial aid and is available only to US citizens, permanent residents, and certain eligible noncitizens -- not available to international (visa-holding) students, per UCB0024. Source states one shared deadline for three distinct forms (FAFSA, CA Dream Act Application, GPA Verification Form); recorded as three separate rows (this one, DL-UCB0003, DL-UCB0004) per this pass's brief instruction to record residency-based aid distinctions as their own records rather than one generic aid record.
researcher_notes: Filing period for these three forms OPENS October 1, 2026 per the same source page (not recorded as its own deadline row, consistent with this lane's precedent of not recording 'opens' dates as deadlines). Confirmed on the Berkeley-specific dates-deadlines page too, listed there as 'FAFSA and CA Dream Act deadline: March 2' -- consistent, no conflict.

deadline_text_verbatim: Deadline for applicants to submit FAFSA, California Dream Act Application and GPA Verification Form.
limitations: California Dream Act Application is for AB 540-eligible students (see requirement UCB0025) -- a California-residency-track category, not a synonym for 'international.' Same shared source date as DL-UCB0002/DL-UCB0004; split into its own row per this pass's brief.
researcher_notes: See DL-2026-08-21-UCB0005 for a companion record documenting that the DEDICATED California Dream Act eligibility page (ca-dream-act.html) itself still showed stale dates (Oct 2025-March 2026, the closed Fall 2026 cycle) at retrieval time -- this record uses the correctly-cycled Fall 2027 date from the general dates-and-deadlines page instead.

deadline_text_verbatim: Deadline for applicants to submit FAFSA, California Dream Act Application and GPA Verification Form.
limitations: GPA Verification Form is 'required for Cal Grant consideration' per the source page -- a California state grant program, so domestic/CA-track specific. Same shared source date as DL-UCB0002/DL-UCB0003; split into its own row per this pass's brief.

cycle_label: Fall 2026 (stale at retrieval -- do not treat as current)

Recorded deliberately, per this lane's VERIFIED_HISTORICAL convention (see the Erasmus Rotterdam precedent in the wave-1 research-handoff document), specifically to stop a later pass from re-fetching this same still-live-but-stale page and mistaking it for the current date.
researcher_notes: The CORRECT current Fall 2027 date (March 2, 2027) for this same underlying fact is recorded separately at DL-2026-08-21-UCB0003, sourced from the general dates-and-deadlines page, which WAS current/correctly cycle-labeled ('2026-27' header, 'Fall 2027' row labels) at retrieval. This dedicated eligibility page (ca-dream-act.html) was used only for the AB 540/Dream Act ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA text (requirement UCB0025), not for its own date, precisely because of this staleness.

deadline_text_verbatim: Deadline for all fall 2027 admitted first-year students to submit their SIR.
limitations: SIR = Statement of Intent to Register, the enrollment-confirmation step after an admission offer -- this is application-readiness/enrollment tracking, not an admission-eligibility deadline.
researcher_notes: Corroborated on the Berkeley-specific dates-deadlines page as 'First-year deadline to accept offer of admission: May 1' -- consistent, no conflict.

deadline_text_verbatim: Final, official transcripts must be postmarked or electronically submitted to campus admissions offices for students intending to enroll for fall 2027.
researcher_notes: Post-admission document-finalization deadline for enrolling students, distinct from the initial application deadline (DL-UCB0001).

deadline_text_verbatim: Deadline for official AP and IB examination results to be postmarked or electronically submitted.
researcher_notes: Relevant for students using AP/IB scores toward subject credit/placement or toward the English-proficiency alternative pathway (UCB0016).

deadline_text_verbatim: Letters of recommendation are due January 10. All letters will be due by 11:59 p.m. on January 10.
limitations: No year stated on Berkeley's own live policy page -- do not synthesize a year onto this date. By page context (describing the current/upcoming application cycle at time of retrieval) this most likely corresponds to January 10, 2027, but that specific year is an inference, not a stated fact, so cycle_year is left null per this lane's discipline.
researcher_notes: Applies only to the subset of applicants invited to submit letters (see requirement UCB0021) -- not a universal deadline. 'After this date, it is not guaranteed that the letter can be read as part of the application review' per the source page (soft/practical deadline framing rather than an absolute cutoff, but recorded at face value).

deadline_text_verbatim: Students will need to have satisfied English Proficiency by no later than January 31st
limitations: No year stated on the source page -- not synthesized. Plausibly the same item as the 'UC Berkeley mandatory forms deadline: January 31' line found on Berkeley's general dates-deadlines page, but this was not confirmed to be the identical item (that page does not specify what the 'mandatory forms' are) -- recorded as its own row rather than merged, to avoid asserting an identity that isn't confirmed.
researcher_notes: Distinct from the TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo score thresholds themselves (UCB0011-0016) -- this is the deadline BY WHICH an international applicant's proficiency documentation must be complete, not a score value.
